title: Normalized integral Roos descent for a finite clopen cover
statement: For a finite disjoint open and closed cover $j_i:X_i\to X$ of schemes and the completed integral coefficient sheaves fixed by the purity conventions [def-pur-conventions], let $r_i$ be the ordinary completed integral restriction functors [def-pur-clopen-integral-restriction]. The unbounded derived categories admit countable products, and the tuple of these exact derived restriction functors is an equivalence. For any countable family $K_n$, there are product isomorphisms $r_i(\prod_n K_n)\cong\prod_n r_iK_n$ whose forward maps are the canonical product comparisons. For every tower transition, augmentation and connecting morphism, the corresponding actual Roos triangle is distinguished if and only if all its images under restriction, these product comparisons and the canonical shift comparisons are distinguished. This includes empty components and the empty partition.

source.place: Tags 04TS, 07KC and 08TC; the complete integralRoosCalculus proof already present in augmented integral descent.

from.place: Node step 3, the normalized integral Roos calculation used by augmented descent.

proof.text: Glue completed integral module sheaves on the finite clopen cover, then compose with the canonical coefficient-transport equivalences. This gives an additive equivalence whose forward functor is exactly the tuple of the ordinary restrictions. It jointly reflects isomorphisms, so the finite-product derived-localization calculation makes the specified tuple of derived restriction functors an equivalence.

Completed integral module sheaves have exact countable products, both on X and on each component. Thus the chosen unbounded derived categories have countable products. Ordinary restriction preserves countable products: forget the module action and identify it with presheaf precomposition, then reflect limits through the faithful forgetful functor. Exact derived restriction therefore preserves the countable products.

Apply the normalized limit-triangle descent theorem to these exact derived functors. It supplies the product isomorphisms with hom equal to the canonical product comparison, and states distinguishedness reflection with precisely the augmentation, transition and connecting maps in the conclusion. The construction does not require a nonempty indexing type and applies to empty components as well.

theorem integralClopenRoosCalculus :
    Nonempty (HasCountableProducts
      (DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left))) ∧
    (∀ i, Nonempty (HasCountableProducts
      (DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource P.coefficients.l P.extension (Xi i).left)))) ∧
    (Functor.pi' (fun i ↦
      clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left)).IsEquivalence ∧
    ∀ (K : ℕ → DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left))
      [HasProduct K]
      [∀ i, HasProduct (fun n ↦ (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l
        P.extension (j i).left).obj (K n))],
      ∃ φ : ∀ i, (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension
          (j i).left).obj (∏ᶜ K) ≅
        ∏ᶜ (fun n ↦ (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension
          (j i).left).obj (K n)),
        (∀ i, (φ i).hom = piComparison
          (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left) K) ∧
        ∀ (t : ∀ n, K (n + 1) ⟶ K n)
          (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left))
          (c : M ⟶ ∏ᶜ K) (δ : ∏ᶜ K ⟶ M⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
          IsDerivedLimitTriangle t M c δ ↔ ∀ i,
            IsDerivedLimitTriangle
              (fun n ↦ (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension
                (j i).left).map (t n))
              ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).obj M)
              ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).map c ≫
                (φ i).hom)
              ((φ i).inv ≫
                (clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).map δ ≫
                ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension
                  (j i).left).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app M)
